blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two members of the prosecution team have reminded Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers that the issue with Cale88 Foods Corporation is not whether it is a registered business, but on its allegedly undeclared income. In a press briefing on Friday after a break in Duterte’s impeachment trial, public prosecutor Manila Rep. Joel Chua and prosecution spokesperson Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong both highlighted that Cale88’s registration with the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) was never questioned. Cale88 is the company owned by Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, and her dentist Lourdes Lebosada. It was reflected […]...
